name: kandel
description: Per-process supervision for the Windows interactive session. Built with Rust and Tauri.

scripts.build: pnpm run prebuild && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:ui
scripts.build:core: cargo build --release -p kandel-core && shx cp target/release/kandel.exe build/kandel.exe
scripts.build:ui: tauri build --config crates/kandel-ui/tauri.conf.json && shx cp target/release/kandel-ui.exe build/kandel-ui.exe
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run package
